data-title="What could you learn from the very best minds in design?<br>
<br>
The Conversations in Design talks programme at Focus/26 on Design brings together A-list designers, leading editors and some of the industry’s most respected creative minds to share their knowledge, experience and expertise.<br>
<br>
It’s a rare opportunity to listen to the people behind some of the world’s most exciting interiors, projects and collections, with unparalleled access to the thinking, ideas and experiences that have shaped their work.<br>
<br>
Come ready to listen, learn and take notes. Leave with fresh perspectives, invaluable insights and ideas to bring back to your own projects.<br>
<br>
Tickets are £10. Book your place via the link in bio 🔗<br>
<br>
More talks to be released soon!<br>
<br>
Speakers and moderators: Linda Morey-Burrows, principal director and founder of @moreysmith and @philipbershad, President and co-CEO of @phillipjeffriesltd, Martin Waller, founder of @andrewmartin_int, @mrbspriggs, editor in chief @elledecorationuk, @lorenzocastillofe, @interiorseditor editor of @houseandgardenuk, @vanessamacdonaldmwltd, Natasha Greig, partner and creative director of @grenneygreig, @annahainesdesigns, @ginnyemily acting editor of @homesandgardensofficial, @indiahicksstyle, @willowkemp design director @kitkempdesignthread, @robertangelldesignint, @carolewannett interiors editor of @countryandtownhouse, @michaelsmithinc, @hattabyng of @createacademyofficial, @geosaumarezsmith partner at @adamarchitecture, Ben Holland co-founder of @hollandgreeninteriors, @vsp_interiors and @giles.kime executive and interiors editor of @countrylifemagazine."

data-title="Celebrating our much loved four-pawed furry friends on International Dog Day, and every day after 🐾🤎<br>
<br>
The newest face to our Design Centre gang, Pip, is the star behind our AW26 Creative Campaign and is perched on the fabulous new ‘Douglas’ dog bed by Kingcome. <br>
<br>
Product credits: <br>
1. ‘Crackle’ rug, lichen, @timpagecarpets <br>
2. ‘Douglas’ dog bed, @kingcomesofas, upholstered in ‘Glen Check’ fabric (F4975-04), olive, @colefaxandfowler<br>
<br>
Park Life: An @andrewmartin_int collaboration with interior designer @sophiepatersoninteriors, is a charming celebration of Britain’s love of dogs.<br>
<br>
Each dog on  has been hand-drawn and painted by Sophie, inspired by the pets of friends, family, and followers who shared their beloved breeds. From elegant pointers to playful dachshunds, the illustrations capture the distinct personality of each companion and are depicted on the collection of fabrics, cushions and wallpaper.   Find the collection in the Andrew Martin Showroom. Ground Floor, North Dome.<br>
<br>
We’d be surprised if you’ve yet to meet miss Mabel in the Design Centre. Making her model debut here in the @phillipjeffriesltd Morning Room by @saracosgrovestudio, she can concur that the custom dog bed, lined with ‘Cameron’ wallcovering by Phillip Jeffries was a dogs dream chill spot. <br>
<br>
Phillip Jeffries showroom is located on the Second Floor, North Dome.<br>
<br>
Bring a little canine charm into your interiors 🐾 ‘Mountain Dogs’ by MindTheGap is full of character, a charming way to give furry friends a place in the design scheme, without compromising on style.<br>
<br>
Discover in the @mindtgap Showroom, Second Floor, Centre Dome.<br>
<br>
Meet Suki, @chaseerwinfabrics’s CEO’s four-legged right hand 🐾 A very important member of the Chase Erwin team, with plenty of personality to match.<br>
<br>
Naturally, she has her own Instagram too: @sukidaboss.<br>
<br>
The Michael S. Smith x Zoffany collaboration has been a design highlight of the summer, and we are thrilled to be welcoming Zoffany x Michael S. Smith & Sharland England to the Design Avenue during Focus/26 on Design… and perhaps have a guest appearance from this fabulous pooch?<br>
<br>
@zoffanyfw @michaelsmithinc @sharland_england<br>
<br>

data-title="WIN! A STAY AT THE ZETTER BLOOMSBURY ✨<br>
<br>
Register for Focus/26 on Design before 1 September and you could win a one-night stay for two, including breakfast, at @thezetterhotels.<br>
<br>
One of London’s newest hospitality hotspots, The Zetter Bloomsbury spans six Georgian townhouses in the heart of Bloomsbury, moments from the British Museum. <br>
<br>
Former WOW!house designer James Thurstan Waterworth of @_thurstan has imagined its eclectic interiors as a comfortable collector’s home, layering antiquities, vintage finds, bespoke rugs and 20th-century artworks to create bedrooms where no two are alike.<br>
<br>
Design Centre, Chelsea Harbour is represented throughout the hotel, with fabrics from @turnellandgigon, @delecuona and @tissusdhelenelondon, trims from @samuelandsons, and Wall Lights from @hectorfinchlighting.<br>
<br>
Register for Focus/26 on Design by 1 September for your chance to win.<br>
<br>
REGISTER NOW via the link.<br>
<br>
Terms & conditions apply."

data-title="A last look at summer by the coast 🌊<br>
<br>
Coastal interiors have moved beyond the obvious, with a softer, more refined take on nautical style. Crisp stripes, breezy blues from @sanderson1860 create rooms that feel relaxed yet considered.<br>
<br>
Perfectly suited to Hamptons-style decorating, it’s a timeless approach to coastal living that captures the ease of summer, long after the season ends.<br>
<br>
Pictured are the 'Caspian', 'Arboretum' and 'One Sixty' collections. <br>
<br>
Discover in the Sanderson showroom. Ground Floor, Centre Dome."

data-title="What could you learn from the very best minds in design?<br>
<br>
The Conversations in Design talks programme at Focus/26 on Design brings together A-list designers, leading editors and some of the industry’s most respected creative minds to share their knowledge, experience and expertise.<br>
<br>
It’s a rare opportunity to listen to the people behind some of the world’s most exciting interiors, projects and collections, with unparalleled access to the thinking, ideas and experiences that have shaped their work.<br>
<br>
Come ready to listen, learn and take notes. Leave with fresh perspectives, invaluable insights and ideas to bring back to your own projects.<br>
<br>
Tickets are £10. Book your place via the link in bio 🔗<br>
<br>
More talks to be released soon!<br>
<br>
Speakers and moderators: Linda Morey-Burrows, principal director and founder of @moreysmith and @philipbershad, President and co-CEO of @phillipjeffriesltd, Martin Waller, founder of @andrewmartin_int, @mrbspriggs, editor in chief @elledecorationuk, @lorenzocastillofe, @interiorseditor editor of @houseandgardenuk, @vanessamacdonaldmwltd, Natasha Greig, partner and creative director of @grenneygreig, @annahainesdesigns, @ginnyemily acting editor of @homesandgardensofficial, @indiahicksstyle, @willowkemp design director @kitkempdesignthread, @robertangelldesignint, @carolewannett interiors editor of @countryandtownhouse, @michaelsmithinc, @hattabyng of @createacademyofficial, @geosaumarezsmith partner at @adamarchitecture, Ben Holland co-founder of @hollandgreeninteriors, @vsp_interiors and @giles.kime executive and interiors editor of @countrylifemagazine."

data-title="Celebrating our much loved four-pawed furry friends on International Dog Day, and every day after 🐾🤎<br>
<br>
The newest face to our Design Centre gang, Pip, is the star behind our AW26 Creative Campaign and is perched on the fabulous new ‘Douglas’ dog bed by Kingcome. <br>
<br>
Product credits: <br>
1. ‘Crackle’ rug, lichen, @timpagecarpets <br>
2. ‘Douglas’ dog bed, @kingcomesofas, upholstered in ‘Glen Check’ fabric (F4975-04), olive, @colefaxandfowler<br>
<br>
Park Life: An @andrewmartin_int collaboration with interior designer @sophiepatersoninteriors, is a charming celebration of Britain’s love of dogs.<br>
<br>
Each dog on  has been hand-drawn and painted by Sophie, inspired by the pets of friends, family, and followers who shared their beloved breeds. From elegant pointers to playful dachshunds, the illustrations capture the distinct personality of each companion and are depicted on the collection of fabrics, cushions and wallpaper.   Find the collection in the Andrew Martin Showroom. Ground Floor, North Dome.<br>
<br>
We’d be surprised if you’ve yet to meet miss Mabel in the Design Centre. Making her model debut here in the @phillipjeffriesltd Morning Room by @saracosgrovestudio, she can concur that the custom dog bed, lined with ‘Cameron’ wallcovering by Phillip Jeffries was a dogs dream chill spot. <br>
<br>
Phillip Jeffries showroom is located on the Second Floor, North Dome.<br>
<br>
Bring a little canine charm into your interiors 🐾 ‘Mountain Dogs’ by MindTheGap is full of character, a charming way to give furry friends a place in the design scheme, without compromising on style.<br>
<br>
Discover in the @mindtgap Showroom, Second Floor, Centre Dome.<br>
<br>
Meet Suki, @chaseerwinfabrics’s CEO’s four-legged right hand 🐾 A very important member of the Chase Erwin team, with plenty of personality to match.<br>
<br>
Naturally, she has her own Instagram too: @sukidaboss.<br>
<br>
The Michael S. Smith x Zoffany collaboration has been a design highlight of the summer, and we are thrilled to be welcoming Zoffany x Michael S. Smith & Sharland England to the Design Avenue during Focus/26 on Design… and perhaps have a guest appearance from this fabulous pooch?<br>
<br>
@zoffanyfw @michaelsmithinc @sharland_england<br>
<br>

data-title="WIN! A STAY AT THE ZETTER BLOOMSBURY ✨<br>
<br>
Register for Focus/26 on Design before 1 September and you could win a one-night stay for two, including breakfast, at @thezetterhotels.<br>
<br>
One of London’s newest hospitality hotspots, The Zetter Bloomsbury spans six Georgian townhouses in the heart of Bloomsbury, moments from the British Museum. <br>
<br>
Former WOW!house designer James Thurstan Waterworth of @_thurstan has imagined its eclectic interiors as a comfortable collector’s home, layering antiquities, vintage finds, bespoke rugs and 20th-century artworks to create bedrooms where no two are alike.<br>
<br>
Design Centre, Chelsea Harbour is represented throughout the hotel, with fabrics from @turnellandgigon, @delecuona and @tissusdhelenelondon, trims from @samuelandsons, and Wall Lights from @hectorfinchlighting.<br>
<br>
Register for Focus/26 on Design by 1 September for your chance to win.<br>
<br>
REGISTER NOW via the link.<br>
